purpose: Test whether the skill separates cast identities and preserves each identity under common AI-video stressors.

scenarios.brief: Two women in their 20s argue in a convenience store without looking like variants of one influencer face.
acceptance: speech does not enlarge eyes or narrow jaw

scenarios.brief: Adult siblings should plausibly share family resemblance without becoming identical.
acceptance: two or three shared axes only
stable individual profile and expression cues

scenarios.brief: A four-person cast spanning 19 to 70 in one waiting room.
One character turns from frontal to near-profile and back.
acceptance: nose length and jaw silhouette remain stable

scenarios.brief: A close-up delivers a short emotional line and ends in a restrained smile.
acceptance: eye aperture and spacing remain stable
smile does not beautify or symmetrize face

scenarios.brief: Two characters enter a highly stylized neon environment without inheriting faces from the style reference.
acceptance: style changes color and texture only

scenarios.brief: A character briefly passes behind a foreground object and reappears.
Compare a clip before and after face restoration.
